给它起个名字，比如 Claude Code: Give it a name, e.g. Claude Code
先撤销，再从列表里删掉: Revoke it before removing it from the list
一个数据库最多 {n} 行: A database can have at most {n} rows
页面太大（最多 {n}K 字）: The page is too big (max {n}K characters)
版本号不对：页面现在是版本 {v}: Wrong version: the page is now at version {v}
版本号要是整数: The version must be a whole number
回收站里没有这一项: That item is not in the trash
这一行所在的数据库已经不在了，恢复不了: This row's database no longer exists, so it can't be restored
不能挪到它自己或者它的子页面下面: A page can't be moved under itself or one of its subpages
数据库的行不能挪出数据库: Database rows can't be moved out of their database
数据库的行只能在数据库里: Database rows can only live in a database
数据库和它的行下面不能放子页面: Databases and their rows can't have subpages
文件太大了（最多 {n} MB）: The file is too large (max {n} MB)
只支持 PNG、JPG、WebP、GIF 图片: Only PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF images are supported
评论太长（最多 {n} 字）: The comment is too long (max {n} characters)
只有 markdown 页面能按段改: Only markdown pages can be edited block by block
数据库的表结构改动在库的“历史”里撤销: Undo changes to a database's properties from the database's History
每个修改都要是一个对象: Each change must be an object
链接已失效: This link is no longer valid
